title: Ground Beef Tortilla Triangles
summary: Ingredients * 1 lb ground beef * ½ tsp paprika * Salt (1 year+ only) * Black pepper * 6 flour tortillas * 4 oz cream cheese * ½ cup pizza sauce * 1½ cups shredded mozzarella * ½ tsp oregano (optional) * Avocado oil spray…
steps: Cook the ground beef with paprika, pepper, and salt if serving 1 year+.
Cut the tortillas into circles, then add three thick sections of cream cheese around the edges.
Fold between each section to create a triangle with three creamy bumps and an open center.
Fill the center with pizza sauce, ground beef, and mozzarella.
Sprinkle with oregano, spray with avocado oil, and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 12–15 minutes until golden and crispy
caption: Day 10 of 30 family dinners toddlers actually eat 🤍 Ground Beef Tortilla Triangles 🌮 Ingredients * 1 lb ground beef * ½ tsp paprika * Salt (1 year+ only) * Black pepper * 6 flour tortillas * 4 oz cream cheese * ½ cup pizza sauce * 1½ cups shredded mozzarella * ½ tsp oregano (optional) * Avocado oil spray Directions Cook the ground beef with paprika, pepper, and salt if serving 1 year+. Cut the tortillas into circles, then add three thick sections of cream cheese around the edges. Fold between each section to create a triangle with three creamy bumps and an open center. Fill the center with pizza sauce, ground beef, and mozzarella.
